title: Hino FE Fups Compatable Hight Tensile Alumuminium Bullbar #12
description: Hino FE FUPS compatible 4post hi-tensile polished aluminium heavy duty bull bar with heavy duty box style uprights. One piece heavy duty 76mm diam. cross pipes. Contoured extra heavy duty main channel with heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate. Custom built to suit aftermarket Hella H4 headlight assemblies. Combination indicator repeater and daylight running lights in outer box uprights. Provision for truck mounted Radar sensor. Dangerous Goods sign mounted on mounting plate. Custom driving light mounts to customer specification.
